items.title: Re-vendor LibKa0s v1.71.0 (kit 38) from the local tag; record it plus the unrecorded v1.69.0/v1.70.0 span bundle
items.spec:
Mechanical re-vendor per the dev-copilot:wow-revendor-libka0s convention, non-interactive (OWNER_SCOPE 5: no interview, no issue filing).
- Payloads: replace libs/LibKa0s/ whole with ../LibKa0s LibKa0s/ at the LOCAL tag v1.71.0 and tests/_kit/ whole with ../LibKa0s testkit/ at that tag (export from the tag, e.g. `git -C ../LibKa0s archive v1.71.0 LibKa0s testkit | tar -x -C <tmp>`, never from the LibKa0s working tree). No other edits under libs/ or tests/_kit/.
- CLAUDE.md '## Vendored LibKa0s — the provenance line': `Bundles [LibKa0s](...) v1.71.0 (MIT).` and `That tag carries test-kit revision 38`, in the same commit as the bytes (tests/test_vendor_sync.lua reads it).
- docs/test-cases.md regenerated with `lua tests/run.lua --list` (CRLF per its banner) in the same commit: kit 38 (LK-01) moves the declared skip out of the count rows onto a `| Skipped | N |` row, so `| **Total** |` (1259 today, docs/test-cases.md:1472) becomes the number of cases that run and MUST equal the README.md:7 Tests badge (1258/1258 today; if kit 38's own vendored suites change the runnable count, the badge moves to the new Total). This closes BL-A-03 with no local framework edit.
- Contract check (Autocomplete minor 2, LK-04): the host must set the box's scripts before calling lib.Autocomplete. modules/Browser.lua sets OnTextChanged/OnEscapePressed/OnEnterPressed (about :1094-:1101) before `self:MakeAutocomplete(search, ...)` (about :1105) and never SetScripts a hooked script afterwards: record it in 01_DELTA as satisfied, no code change. BankLedger consumes no LineChart (LK-03 ClipSegment/hover resync is not a consumer change) and no Slash ParseValue nan/inf path beyond what the library owns.
- docs/revendor/2026-10-07-v1.71.0/: 01_DELTA.md (line 1 exactly `Delta: LibKa0s v1.70.0 -> v1.71.0`; base taken from the CLAUDE.md provenance line, v1.70.0; per-file LibStub minors before/after: Env 2, Slash key 20.2, Widgets key 12.1.4.3.2 (LineChart 3, Autocomplete 2), Options key with OptionsIdList 4; kit 37 -> 38; payload diff stats; majors this addon consumes; the Autocomplete precondition check above), 02_CANDIDATES.md (Kit.secret / Kit.installSecretValue, ChartMath.ClipSegment, any other new surface: each 'not adopted in this run' per OWNER_SCOPE 5), 05_SUMMARY.md (re-vendored, nothing adopted, no issues filed, Totals now equal badge).
- docs/revendor/2026-10-07-v1.69.0-v1.70.0/ (the consolidated span bundle for the re-vendors b5e638b (v1.69.0) and 2c87997 (v1.70.0) that left no record): 01_DELTA.md whose line 1 is exactly `Delta: LibKa0s v1.69.0 -> v1.70.0 (span: v1.69.0 v1.70.0)`, body naming base v1.68.1, both commits, what arrived (Widgets LineChart and Autocomplete, kit 37); 05_SUMMARY.md with `- v1.69.0: carried by sweep, nothing adopted` and `- v1.70.0: Autocomplete adopted in e5cd620` (feat(search) autocomplete under the search box; modules/Browser.lua, modules/LedgerTable.lua, tests/test_autocomplete.lua). Only 01 and 05 (span-bundle shape, as docs/revendor/2026-10-01-v1.64.0-v1.65.0/).
- Commit subject `RV-BL: re-vendor LibKa0s v1.71.0 (kit 38) ...`; one commit.
items.steps:
1. Confirm `git -C ../LibKa0s tag -l v1.71.0` exists and points at LK-12's second commit; read the v1.71.0 CHANGELOG block and 'What a consumer owes'.
2. Export the tag to a scratch dir; `rm -rf libs/LibKa0s tests/_kit` and copy both payloads whole.
3. Roll the CLAUDE.md provenance line (v1.71.0, kit 38).
4. `lua tests/run.lua` and `luacheck .` green (test_vendor_sync compares against the tag).
5. `lua tests/run.lua --list > docs/test-cases.md` (CRLF); check Total equals the badge; move the badge if the runnable count changed.
6. Verify the Autocomplete scripts-first precondition in modules/Browser.lua by reading it.
7. Write both revendor bundles; commit `RV-BL: ...`.

items.title: LT.GroupEntries back under CCN 15: module-level group comparators, characterization case first
items.spec: modules/LedgerTable.lua LT:GroupEntries (about :320-:364) measures CCN 16 since 5a78432 added `or groupOrder` to the sortKey default (:339); it is the only BankLedger function over the release gate. Chosen shape (one, no per-call closure): two module-level named comparators `groupAscending(a, b)` and `groupDescending(a, b)` defined above GroupEntries, each comparing `sortKey` and tie-breaking on `key` ascending exactly as the current inline closure does; GroupEntries calls `table.sort(order, (self.groupAsc ~= false) and groupAscending or groupDescending)`. If lizard still reads 16 after that, also hoist the sortKey default into a module-level `groupSortKey(sortFn, e, groupOrder, valueLabel)` returning `sortFn and sortFn(e) or groupOrder or valueLabel` (identical precedence). Behaviour is unchanged: the ordering of groups, headers, counts, collapse handling and in-group row order are byte-identical. A short comment names the reason (automated-tests-§3 CCN gate). Not an unnamed body dump.
items.steps:
1. Characterization first: in tests/test_ledgertable.lua add cases pinning grouped ordering under groupBy = the Type & SubType grouping (typesub) in DESCENDING order (self.groupAsc = false) and ascending, including a tie on sortKey broken by key, and a column-backed grouping where sortFn wins over groupOrder; they pass against today's code (characterization), with a `-- red under:` note naming the mutation each would catch (e.g. tie-break flipped, groupOrder ignored).
2. Hoist the comparators (and groupSortKey if needed).
3. `lizard -l lua -x './libs/*' -x './tests/_kit/*' modules/LedgerTable.lua` shows GroupEntries <= 15.
4. Green gate; regenerate docs/test-cases.md (CRLF) and move the README Tests badge to the new Total.
5. Commit `BL-01: ...` carrying both ids in the body (BL-R-01 + BL-A-02).

items.title: Browser search: trimmed query matches the suggestions, one filter pass per ApplyView/tab switch, printer arguments
items.spec:
All in modules/Browser.lua (plus one line in settings/Slash.lua); lands before the BL-03 peel so the peel stays a pure move.
(a) BL-R-04 (C-04): new file-local `searchClause(t)` returning the trimmed text (same `^%s*(.-)%s*$` trim the suggestions' trimLower uses, case preserved) or nil when the result is empty. OnTextChanged (about :1096: `B.activeFilter.text = searchClause(t)`), B:SetSearchText (about :666) and buildActiveFilter (about :846, its search argument) all go through it, so the query the Database textOK matcher sees (core/Database.lua, plain lowered substring find) and the suggestions (_rankSuggestions, :607-608) normalize identically. The box keeps the raw text the player typed (placeholder logic still reads raw ''), and a captured view (CaptureView) stores what it stores today.
(b) BL-R-03 (C-03): a shared file-local `dropFilterDebounce()` that cancels and nils pendingFilterTimer (the body now inline in SetSearchText); SetSearchText and B:ApplyView both call it, ApplyView right after `self._search:SetText(search)` (about :879) and before ApplyFilterNow (:882), so the debounce the client's OnTextChanged arms does not re-run the same filter 0.2 s later. B:SelectTab (about :222-:245): when prev ~= name, SwapTabState has already refreshed the incoming pane, so skip the redundant NS.LedgerTable:Refresh() / NS.Insights:Refresh() and keep B:RefreshFilterOptions() on History; when prev == name (re-select of the current tab, first build) keep today's refresh. B:CancelPending (the stand-down) keeps working through the same helper or unchanged. No perf instrumentation.
(c) BL-A-05 (narrowed): the three pre-formatted printer calls pass values as printer arguments (the BL-17 / 17568e2 idiom, NS.Print joins its arguments): B:SaveView (about :901) and B:ResetView (about :915) print `lastTab` as its own argument instead of `("%s view ..."):format(lastTab)`; settings/Slash.lua:111 (Sl:ResetEverything) passes the profile name as an argument rather than joining it with `..`. Keep the player-visible wording as close as the idiom allows; update any test that pins the exact line. Leave Slash.lua:253, Slash.lua:339 and core/DebugLogSetup.lua:51 alone (verdict: not deviations).
items.steps:
1. Red first (tests/test_browser.lua or tests/test_filters.lua): (i) with a ledger holding 'Linen Cloth', SetSearchText(' linen') and SetSearchText('cloth ') leave the Linen Cloth rows visible and activeFilter.text == 'linen' / 'cloth'; a whitespace-only text yields activeFilter.text == nil; also via the box's OnTextChanged script and via ApplyView with view.search = ' linen'. Fails today. (ii) ApplyView with a search: instrument the mock so SetText fires OnTextChanged (tests/wow_mock.lua:261 does not; drive the script by hand in the test if the mock cannot), then assert pendingFilterTimer is nil / ApplyFilter ran once after ApplyView. Fails today. (iii) SelectTab('Insights') from History calls NS.Insights:Refresh at most once (count via a spy) and SelectTab('History') from Insights calls LedgerTable:Refresh at most once while RefreshFilterOptions still runs. Fails today. Add `-- red under:` notes.
2. Implement searchClause, dropFilterDebounce and the SelectTab guard.
3. Printer arguments at the three sites; adjust pinned-line tests.
4. Green gate; lizard (no function above 15); `wc -l modules/Browser.lua` stays < 1500; regenerate docs/test-cases.md; badge.
5. Commit `BL-02: ...` naming BL-R-04, BL-R-03, BL-A-05.

items.title: Peel the per-tab view machinery out of modules/Browser.lua into modules/Browser_Views.lua (pure move)
items.spec: modules/Browser.lua is 1427/1500 lines (layout-§1 band) and its tracked BL-24 seam was never cut. ONE pure-move peel (do not also do the skin/geometry peel): the per-tab view section (about :713-:986 today, shifted by BL-02: defaultCharSelection, savedSlots, savedViewOrStock, asSet, the STOCK_VIEW/view helpers, tableViewState, B:CaptureView, applyTableState, viewSets, paintDropdowns, buildActiveFilter, searchClause if it is only used there (otherwise exposed on B as a private helper), B:ApplyView, B:ClearFilters, B:SaveView, B:ResetView, applyBaseline, forgetTabStates, B:SwapTabState, B:ClearAllTabs, B:OnDatasetChanged) moves verbatim into new modules/Browser_Views.lua, which opens with the standard file header, takes `local _, NS = ...`, `local B = NS.Browser`, and receives the file-locals it needs from Browser.lua through a small explicit seam table (e.g. `B._viewSeam = { ApplyFilter = ..., getLastTab = function() return lastTab end, ... }`), never new globals; locals that both files mutate (lastTab, pendingFilterTimer) stay owned by Browser.lua and are reached through accessors. BankLedger.toc: `modules\Browser_Views.lua` on the line right after `modules\Browser.lua` with a `# LOAD-ORDER:` comment saying why (extends NS.Browser; must load after it and before anything that calls the view API at OnEnable). Every public B method keeps its name and behaviour; no test changes count (tests that reach file-locals through B._ test hooks keep working via the same names). Same commit: docs/module-map.md gains the Browser_Views.lua row and Browser.lua's row is narrowed; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md load-order list gains the line; the ARCHITECTURE over-cap census sentence (about :460) is rewritten without a line figure (names the largest authored file and the `git ls-files ... | xargs wc -l | sort -n` command only, per BL-A-04's ruling); docs/automated-tests/RESULTS.md watch-list row for modules/Browser.lua (:103, '1221', BL-24) is refreshed: the per-tab view seam is cut, the remaining named seam is the skin/close-button factory and geometry persistence, the current line count is read with wc at commit time (this live table is the one place a figure belongs); re-read the standalone-windows deviation register condition (3) in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/windows.md and update it if it names Browser.lua as the single home of the view logic. tests/test_browser.lua and tests/test_profiles.lua are left as they are.
items.steps:
1. Baseline: `lua tests/run.lua` total and `lua tests/run.lua --list | md5sum` recorded.
2. Cut the section into modules/Browser_Views.lua; add the seam; TOC line + LOAD-ORDER comment; add the file to any test loader list (tests/run.lua or the TOC-driven loader; tests/test_toc or the layout gate must see it).
3. Green gate; the case list is identical to the baseline (same count, same names); lizard clean; `wc -l modules/Browser.lua modules/Browser_Views.lua` both well under 1000 for Browser_Views and Browser.lua below 1221.
4. Docs: module-map, ARCHITECTURE load order + census sentence + register re-read, RESULTS.md watch row, windows.md if it names the file layout.
5. Commit `BL-03: ...`.

items.title: Docs drift sweep: Logo-art pointers, the mono-glyph comment, per-tab saved views, session-only lastTab, PANEL-28 both tabs
items.spec:
Docs and comments only (documentation-§5).
BL-A-04: core/Constants.lua:235 and docs/smoke-tests.md:113 re-point 'ARCHITECTURE ▸ Logo art' to `docs/media.md ▸ Logo art` (the heading at docs/media.md about :104); modules/LedgerTable.lua:28-30 comment is reworded so the ▲/▼ mono glyph cites debug-logging-§2's sanctioned mono-face exception and drops 'accepted, documented deviation' and the 'See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md ▸ Documented deviations' pointer (there is no register row and none is needed); the ARCHITECTURE over-cap census figure was already dropped by BL-03 (verify it).
BL-R-05: schema v5 keeps profile.savedViews per tab (History, Insights) and lastTab is a session-only file-local (modules/Browser.lua `local lastTab`, remembered within a session). docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (about :92 and :103), docs/settings-panel.md (about :200) and docs/slash-dispatch.md (about :141) say 'one saved view per tab' / 'saved views' instead of a single saved view; docs/debug.md (about :89) says the active tab is remembered for the session only and is never written to SavedVariables; docs/smoke-tests.md PANEL-28 (about :199-:202) is extended: save a view on BOTH History and Insights before Reset all settings ▸ Yes, and expect both saved views discarded (Clear on each tab lands on stock). Line numbers shifted by earlier items: locate by text. No smoke result is recorded or marked passed by the agent.

items.title: Roll the standards reference to WowAddonStandards v2.77.0 and sync docs for this run's changes
items.spec: Per dev-copilot:wow-revendor-standards, against the WowAddonStandards feature branch (`head -1 ../WowAddonStandards/standards/STANDARDS.md` reads v2.77.0 once WS-11 lands). The three-place standards reference (BankLedger.toc `## X-Standard:`, README.md Standard badge, CLAUDE.md 'Standards compliance') is checked and rolled to whatever v2.77.0 prescribes: today all three carry the unversioned repo URL / badge, so they change only if v2.77.0 asks for a pinned version or new wording. Sweep live docs and comments (excluding libs/, tests/_kit/ and the frozen docs/audits/, docs/reviews/, docs/automated-tests/<stamp>/, docs/revendor/ and docs/superpowers/ bundles) for retired notation, retired file names and section references that no longer resolve in v2.77.0 (notably anything WS-03/WS-04/WS-05/WS-08 renamed or re-scoped: the line-endings shebang carve-outs, toc-file-§5, documentation-§3/§6/§8 ordinals, versioning-git branch wording) and fix them; a citation in a code comment is corrected comment-only. Docs sync of this run: README.md Tests badge equals docs/test-cases.md Total; docs/testing.md mentions kit revision 38 / the Skipped row if it describes the Totals table; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md Documentation map and module map agree with Browser_Views.lua; DEPENDENCIES.md unchanged unless it cites the LibKa0s version; CLAUDE.md provenance stays v1.71.0. No version bump, no README Version History entry, no CHANGELOG release (OWNER_SCOPE 4).
items.steps:
1. Read the v2.77.0 changelog entry in ../WowAddonStandards (standards/CHANGELOG.md after WS-01) between v2.76.1 and v2.77.0.
2. Apply the three-place roll if v2.77.0 requires it; run the retired-notation / section-ref sweep.
3. Docs sync pass over README.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/testing.md, docs/module-map.md.
4. Green gate; commit `BL-STD: ...`.
